# AGENTS.md

## Generated files

- `plugins/<name>/package.json`, `plugins/<name>/common/` (skills, agents and formulas), `plugins/<name>/agents.src/`, `plugins/<name>/opencode/src/`, `plugins/<name>/claude-hooks.json` and `lib/` are sources. The manifests, `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`, `INVENTORY.md`, `inventory.json`, the copies of `common/` inside each harness tree, `opencode/dist/`, `opencode/<shim>.js`, `claude/dist/` and the Claude Code hook files are output. Never edit output by hand.
- Composed agents (`common/agents/<id>[.opencode].md` with a "Generated by" comment) and translated agents (`common/agents/<id>.claude.md`) are output of `scripts/build.ts`. Edit `agents.src/<id>.md`; the Claude Code translation follows from the OpenCode form.
- `plugins/cad/common/{skills,agents}` and `plugins/cad/opencode/examples` are vendored from the cad-agent tag in `plugins/cad/cad-agent.json`. `bun run cad:sync` re-vendors them and `bun run cad:check` compares them. Never edit them.
- After changing a source, run `bun run build`. Before every commit, run `bun run check`.

## Tooling

- Tooling comes from `@srobroek/harness-kit`, pinned exactly in `package.json` and configured by `harness-kit.json`. Do not copy its scripts into this repository. `scripts/` holds what is specific to these plugins: bundling, agent composition and translation, and content checks.
- The package version and the workflow tags (`srobroek/harness-kit/.github/workflows/*.yml@vX.Y.Z`) are the same version. Bump them together, run `bun run build`, and commit as `chore(deps): bump @srobroek/harness-kit to X.Y.Z`.
- `bun` and `just` must be on `PATH`. `mise install` installs both at the versions in `.mise.toml`. Run `harness-kit` through `bunx harness-kit` or the `package.json` scripts.
- Stack, toolchain versions, layout and CI: [docs/engineering.md](docs/engineering.md).

## Commands

- `just install` (`bun install --frozen-lockfile`), then `just build` (`scripts/build.ts`, then `harness-kit build`). Each `just` recipe runs the `package.json` script of the same name, so `bun run build` does the same.
- `bun run check` is `harness-kit check`: generated files are current and every Claude Code tree validates. `bun run build:check` is the same for the bundles and composed agents.
- `just verify` runs every gate CI runs; `justfile` has one recipe per script. Use bun for installs and scripts, never npm.
- `bun test`, `bun run typecheck` and `bun run lint` (Biome).
- Content checks: `plugin-table:check`, `steering`, `pitfalls`, `agent-roles`, `descriptions` and `concerns`. CI runs them in the `repo-checks` job.
- A test that does real process or git work sets a measured timeout, usually `setDefaultTimeout(30_000)` with a comment giving the measurement, or uses a cheaper fixture. Signal only PIDs you started, never `pkill -f` or `killall`.
- `bun scripts/check-test-executables.ts` fails when a `*.test.ts` file writes an executable directly instead of through `writeExecutable` from `@srobroek/opencode-lib/executable-fixture`.

## Conventions

- Plugins are OpenCode V2 plugins: `opencode/src/index.ts` default-exports `Plugin.define({ id, setup })` from `@opencode/plugin`. Do not use the V1 API (`@opencode-ai/plugin`). Plugin ids are `srobroek.<name>`; tool names are `<name>_<verb>`.
- `lib/` is the shared library, imported as `@srobroek/opencode-lib/<module>` and inlined into each bundle. No plugin imports another plugin. Code two plugins need goes into `lib/`, and a test that spans plugins goes into `tests/`.
- Each plugin's `agent-plugins.entries` and `claudeEntries` name the bundles `scripts/build.ts` builds. `@opentui/*` and `solid-js` are host modules (`HOST_MODULES` in `scripts/build.ts`): OpenCode supplies them at runtime. Pin them in the root `package.json` to the version in the targeted OpenCode release.
- Runtime `dependencies` of a bundle are inlined at build time, so they sit in the root `package.json`.
- `{{include <fragment>}}` lines in `agents.src/<id>.md` inline `lib/src/<fragment>.md`. `{{include shared/<id>}}` inlines `shared/agents/<id>.md`, the one body of an agent that several plugins ship; each plugin keeps its own frontmatter in `agents.src/<id>.md`.
- Shipped agents name a model-roles tier (`cheap`, `standard`, `strong`, `reviewer`, `orchestrate`) in the `x-opencode-model-role` request header and pin no model. Only `delivery` keeps per-agent fallback models.
- Exact version pins in skills, docs and `.mcp.json` (`uvx pkg@1.2.3`, `npx -y pkg@1.2.3`) keep the shapes Renovate's custom managers match.
- Keep decision logic in pure exported functions and test them directly; keep `setup` a thin adapter over the plugin context. Return the cleanup function from `setup`.
- Every request lists each skill and agent description and each tool's first description line, so keep them short. `bun run descriptions` enforces the limits.
- A skill records recurring failures in `references/pitfalls.md`; `bun run pitfalls` checks the link and the entry format. A language skill fills every concern of the toolchain spec; `bun run concerns` checks it.
- Do not inject changing state into the system prompt on every request; it breaks provider prompt caching.

## Commits

Conventional Commits. A release is derived from `feat` and `fix` commits under `plugins/<name>/`. Scope is the plugin name, for example `feat(beads): ...`.
